Do not use historical P1/CCTI/OGR row counts or earlier FIAA normalization attempts to select the active game-object population.

The 2,000 ROUTED_OUT records remain in their owning service/organization/education/event/knowledge domains and must not be forced into game-object identity.
All inline repairs preserve a repair state and rationale; no derived or constructed value may be relabeled as source-explicit.
This layer is content-baseline complete, not runtime/integration/playtest certified. GAME_READY still requires the relevant OGR/runtime validation path.
